records_needing_manual_review.reason: Marked not_individually_verified in source database; do not present as verified.

remaining_incomplete_examples.reason: No reliable example sentence was found in the supplied PDF row; do not invent one.

interpretation.records_without_article: Mostly verbs, adjectives, adverbs, phrases and proper names; part-of-speech classification is required before treating these as missing noun articles.
interpretation.noun_records_with_article_but_no_plural: Includes mass/uncountable nouns, month names, collective nouns and other words whose plural is uncommon or context-specific. Each needs a per-word decision; blank plural is not automatically an error.
interpretation.duplicate_policy: Exact/normalized duplicate rows are consolidated; source provenance remains attached to the canonical record.
